extension.summary: Films and TV with Trakt, TMDB and Premiumize
extension.description: SpongeTV brings Trakt syncing, TMDB metadata, Premiumize and your own provider packages together in one add-on. This is a stage 4 test build: browsing, metadata, Trakt, provider packages and playback through Premiumize.
extension.disclaimer: SpongeTV includes no content providers. You are responsible for the provider packages you install.
extension.news: 0.5.0: First Stage 5 (polish) build. Every setting now explains itself at the bottom of the settings screen. Clearing or trimming the cache no longer loses SpongeTV's own resume points. The full history of changes is in changelog.txt, so this note stays within Kodi's limit. Routine sync details only appear in Kodi's log with debug logging on. 0.4.20: Smart Play is more reliable: a moment when Kodi reports nothing playing (for example while the TV switches to 4K) no longer ends it, and an episode that plays to its natural end always counts as watched. Smart Play now writes each step to Kodi's log. "Mark as unwatched" now clears the tick on films and episodes. Resume uses whichever point is newer: SpongeTV's own or Trakt's from another device. 0.4.19: Picking a source Premiumize hasn't cached now tells you so: "Not cached on Premiumize: playing the next ready source", or, if nothing below it is ready, asks you to choose another. Watching to the end marks it watched straight away (reached most people with 0.4.20). 0.4.18: When Playing Next waits for the end credits, it now gives them a few seconds first, so the card doesn't cover the final moments (Settings, Playback: "Wait this many seconds after the credits start", 5 by default). It still never appears later than your seconds setting. Earlier changes: changelog.txt

extension.description: Installs and keeps up to date the add-ons published by MrSpongeHead.
